q: Proverbs says to trust in the LORD with how much of your heart?
why: God wants our full trust.
quote: Trust in the LORD with all your heart

q: Proverbs tells us not to lean on what?
why: Our own understanding is limited.
quote: and lean not on your own understanding

q: Proverbs says if you acknowledge God in all your ways, He will do what?
why: God guides those who trust Him.
quote: and He will make your paths straight.

q: Proverbs warns us not to be wise in whose eyes?
why: Instead, fear the LORD and turn from evil.
quote: Be not wise in your own eyes

q: Proverbs says to honor the LORD with your wealth and with what?
why: God deserves our first and best.
quote: Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your harvest

q: Proverbs says the LORD disciplines whom?
why: Like a father who delights in his son.
quote: for the LORD disciplines the one He loves

q: Proverbs tells a son not to reject what from the LORD?
why: God's correction is a sign of His love.
quote: My son, do not reject the discipline of the LORD

q: Proverbs says a true friend loves when?
why: Real friends stay through hard times.
quote: A friend loves at all times

q: Proverbs says what kind of answer turns away anger?
why: Kind words calm people down.
quote: A gentle answer turns away wrath

q: Proverbs tells the lazy person to learn from which creature?
why: The ant works hard without being told.
quote: Walk in the manner of the ant, O slacker

q: Proverbs says what goes before destruction?
why: A haughty spirit comes before a fall.
quote: Pride goes before destruction

q: Proverbs says a child trained in the way he should go will do what when he is old?
why: Good training lasts a lifetime.
quote: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

q: In its opening chapter, Proverbs says the fear of the LORD is the beginning of what?
why: Fools despise wisdom and discipline.
quote: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge

q: Proverbs says to guard what with all diligence, because springs of life flow from it?
why: What is in the heart shapes all of life.
quote: Guard your heart with all diligence

q: Proverbs says what is detestable to the LORD?
why: Those who deal faithfully are His delight.
quote: Lying lips are detestable to the LORD

q: Proverbs says to commit what to the LORD so that your plans succeed?
why: Then your plans will be achieved.
quote: Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved.

q: Proverbs says a joyful heart is good what?
why: A broken spirit dries up the bones.
quote: A joyful heart is good medicine

q: Proverbs calls the name of the LORD a strong what?
why: The righteous run to it for safety.
quote: The name of the LORD is a strong tower

q: Proverbs says as iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens whom?
why: Friends help each other grow.
quote: As iron sharpens iron, so one man sharpens another.

q: Proverbs says every word of God is what?
why: He is a shield to those who trust Him.
quote: Every word of God is flawless

q: Proverbs says a wife of noble character is far more precious than what?
why: Her worth is beyond price.
quote: She is far more precious than rubies.

q: Proverbs says charm is deceptive and beauty is fleeting, but who is to be praised?
a: A woman who fears the LORD
why: Character matters more than looks.
quote: but a woman who fears the LORD is to be praised.

q: Proverbs says the fear of the LORD is the beginning of what?
why: Knowing the Holy One is understanding.
quote: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom

q: Proverbs says a wise son brings joy to whom?
why: A foolish son brings grief to his mother.
quote: A wise son brings joy to his father

q: Proverbs says a brother is born for what?
why: Family helps in hard times.
quote: and a brother is born for adversity.

q: Proverbs says a harsh word does what?
why: A gentle answer turns away wrath.
quote: but a harsh word stirs up anger.

q: Proverbs says a haughty spirit comes before what?
why: Pride goes before destruction.
quote: and a haughty spirit before a fall.

q: Proverbs says a word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of what?
why: The right word at the right time is beautiful.
quote: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

q: Proverbs compares a fool repeating his folly to what?
a: A dog returning to its vomit
why: Fools keep making the same mistakes.
quote: As a dog returns to its vomit, so a fool repeats his folly.

q: Proverbs says which small creatures make their homes in the rocks?
why: They are weak but wise.
quote: the rock badgers are creatures of little power, yet they make their homes in the rocks

q: Proverbs says which creatures have no king, yet advance in formation?
why: They work together without a ruler.
quote: the locusts have no king, yet they all advance in formation

q: Proverbs says which creature can be caught in the hand, yet is found in kings' palaces?
why: Small things can go far.
quote: and the lizard can be caught in one’s hands, yet it is found in the palaces of kings.

q: Proverbs says the ants, though weak, do what in the summer?
why: They plan ahead.
quote: yet they store up their food in the summer

q: Whose proverbs begin the section that says a wise son brings joy to his father?
why: Solomon wrote many proverbs.
quote: The proverbs of Solomon

q: Proverbs says the righteous run to the name of the LORD and are what?
why: His name is a strong tower.
quote: the righteous run to it and are safe.
